title: Unnamed fortification near Djaafra, Algeria
description: Remains of an ancient fortification of Roman date, recorded by Gsell (AAA, whence BAtlas). The location should lie within 2 km of the BAtlas coordinates: a point along the modern CW 43 road to the east of Djaafra and just past the intersection with the road linking Ouchanene Kebira and Tiâroussine (Bordj Bou Arreridj willaya, Algeria).

properties.description: Coordinates extracted using QGIS from a raster image of Barrington Atlas Map 31 that was georegistered to OpenStreetMap using prominent, stable landscape features. Dates after BAltDir.
properties.title: BAtlas Point Location
